annotations.title: Going-concern doubts, auditor changes and critical audit matters

description: What auditors and companies say when something is wrong, from SEC filings. Going-concern doubt: each 10-K and 10-Q whose text says there is substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue, as a timeline (first raised, still raised, lifted), or across the market the companies whose latest report newly raised it. Auditor changes (8-K Item 4.01): who left and who came, resigned or dismissed, disagreements and reportable events. The latest 10-K's critical audit matters. Each row quotes the filing.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or name. Without it, across the market: the companies whose latest 10-K or 10-Q newly raised a going-concern doubt, or the auditor changes filed, in the last `days`.

days.description: Across the market, how many days back from today; default 30.

limit.description: Most rows in each table; default 12 for a company (its latest reports), 10 across the market.

signal.description: going_concern, auditor_change (8-K Item 4.01), critical_audit_matters (the latest 10-K's auditor's report; a company only) or all. Default: all for a company, going_concern across the market.

name: audit_signals

outputSchema.description: going_concern, auditor_changes and critical_audit_matters are tables: columns, rows in the order of columns, and a note on what each value means; every row quotes the filing and links it. counts says how many filings were found and read.

title: Going-concern doubts, auditor changes and critical audit matters
